extra.message: The session middleware configures no store, expiration, or saveUninitialized restriction. In the declared express-session version, fresh anonymous requests are saved in the default MemoryStore. Repeated requests without cookies to an unmatched URL accumulate sessions without expiration or a capacity limit, exhausting server memory. See the [session defaults](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/expressjs/session/v1.15.6/index.js) and [MemoryStore implementation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/expressjs/session/v1.15.6/session/memory.js).
